scope: Tracked results/ files that the 2026-11-05 publication heads (publish/chain-20261105, the publish/side/* branches, and the research heads they contain or extend) add or change over main (2d003a4) and that are not already in research-evidence-20261012 with the same path and sha256. paths maps each published file to the indices of the branches whose tree holds it. When branches hold different contents at one path, the newest is published at the path and the others under results-variants/<branch>/<path>.
